## Intent

State the problem and resulting behavior.

## Why

Explain why this change is needed.

## Door

State whether this change is reversible or needs an owner decision. Link the approval for an action that requires it.

## Cleanup

State none, done, or needed with a linked issue and a testable Ready when condition.

## Testing

List commands run and results, checks omitted, and failures the change did not cause. Explain any test expectation changes.

## System recap

State the risk and affected area. Describe how the change uses, extends, or adds existing parts.

When a primitive, workspace, or decision changes, update the catalog, decision links, and verification targets in the same PR. For app behavior, include control CLI proof and update the generated Feature Map when routes change. State why any of these do not apply.
